__comment: No cullface anywhere here: the core is a 6x6x6 cube at 5..11, so none of its faces lie on the block boundary. cullface culls against the NEIGHBOUR's occlusion, which meant every face touching a solid block was thrown away and the cable had holes in it wherever it ran along a wall or a floor. cullface is correct only on the arms, whose end caps really are flush with the boundary.
